grammarFocus: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别。
title: Why I Joined the Walking Club
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习，不是官方雅思试题。请先听录音（或阅读录音稿），然后完成10道题。题目包括单选题、填空题和判断题（True/False/Not Given）。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有解释均为中文，并附原文证据。
transcript:
M: Hi, Mei. You look tired. Are you okay?
W: Yeah, I’m fine. I just came back from the walking club. We walked for two hours because the weather was so nice.
M: Two hours? That’s a lot. Why did you join a walking club? You usually prefer staying at home.
W: Well, I joined because my doctor said I need more exercise. But I also wanted to meet new people. So it’s good for my health and it’s social.
M: I see. But isn’t it boring to walk for so long?
W: Not really. We talk while we walk, so the time passes quickly. Although I was tired at first, now I feel more energetic.
M: That sounds good. Can I join you next time?
W: Of course! You can come if you want. But you might find it difficult at the beginning. The first walk is always the hardest.
M: I think I can manage. When do you meet?
W: We meet every Saturday morning at 8 a.m. in the park. But last week we met at 9 because it was raining. The leader said we might change the time if the weather is bad.
M: Okay. So it’s usually at 8, but sometimes at 9?
W: Yes, that’s right. You should check the club’s website before you go. Sometimes they change the meeting place too.
M: Thanks. I’ll check. By the way, do I need special shoes?
W: You can wear any comfortable shoes, but good walking shoes are better. You don’t have to buy expensive ones, though.
M: Good to know. I might come this Saturday. But I’m not sure because I have to work in the morning.
W: That’s fine. You can join us anytime. Even if you’re late, you can still catch up with us.
M: Great. I’ll try my best. Thanks for the information, Mei.
W: You’re welcome. See you on Saturday, maybe!

questions.prompt: Why did Mei join the walking club?
options: Because her doctor told her to exercise and she wanted to meet people.
Because she wanted to lose weight quickly.
Because her friend asked her to join.
Because she had nothing else to do.
answers: Because her doctor told her to exercise and she wanted to meet people.
questions.explanation: Mei明确说加入是因为医生建议多运动，同时想认识新朋友。
questions.evidence: I joined because my doctor said I need more exercise. But I also wanted to meet new people.

questions.prompt: How does Mei feel about walking for two hours now?
options: She feels more energetic.
She feels bored.
She feels it is too difficult.
She feels it is a waste of time.
questions.explanation: Mei说虽然一开始累，但现在感觉更有精力。
questions.evidence: Although I was tired at first, now I feel more energetic.

questions.prompt: What time does the walking club usually meet? (Write the time.)
questions.explanation: Mei说他们每周六早上8点在公园集合。
questions.evidence: We meet every Saturday morning at 8 a.m. in the park.

questions.prompt: What does Mei say about the first walk?
options: It might be difficult.
It is always easy.
It is very short.
It is only for experts.
questions.explanation: Mei提醒对方第一次可能会觉得困难。
questions.evidence: But you might find it difficult at the beginning.

questions.prompt: According to Mei, what should the man do before going?
options: Check the club’s website.
Call the leader.
Buy special shoes.
Bring some water.
questions.explanation: Mei建议出发前查看俱乐部网站，因为有时会改地点。
questions.evidence: You should check the club’s website before you go.

questions.prompt: What kind of shoes does Mei say are better? (Write two words.)
questions.explanation: Mei说穿任何舒服的鞋都可以，但好的步行鞋更好。

questions.prompt: What is the man’s plan for this Saturday?
options: He might come but he is not sure.
He will definitely come.
He will not come at all.
He will come only if it rains.
answers: He might come but he is not sure.
questions.explanation: 男士说可能来，但不确定，因为早上要工作。
questions.evidence: I might come this Saturday. But I’m not sure because I have to work in the morning.

questions.prompt: What does Mei say about being late?
options: You can still catch up with the group.
You cannot join the walk.
You must pay a fine.
You should go home.
answers: You can still catch up with the group.
questions.explanation: Mei说即使迟到，仍然可以赶上队伍。
questions.evidence: Even if you’re late, you can still catch up with us.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The walking club met at 9 a.m. last week because it was raining.
options: True
False
Not Given
questions.explanation: Mei明确说上周因为下雨，他们9点集合。
questions.evidence: But last week we met at 9 because it was raining.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The man has to buy expensive walking shoes.
options: True
False
Not Given
questions.explanation: Mei说不需要买昂贵的鞋，与陈述相反。
questions.evidence: You don’t have to buy expensive ones, though.

vocabulary.example: you can still catch up with us.
You don’t have to buy expensive ones
The leader said we might change the time

grammar.title: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别
grammar.explanation: 原因从句用 because 说明理由；结果从句用 so 说明结果；让步从句用 although / even if 表示“虽然/即使”。may / might 表示“可能”，语气较不确定；can 表示“能够”或“可以”，语气更肯定或表示允许。
grammar.example: Although I was tired at first, now I feel more energetic.

options: Because it was raining, so we stayed at home.
Because it was raining, we stayed at home.
Although it was raining, so we stayed at home.
It was raining because we stayed at home.
answers: Because it was raining, we stayed at home.
questions.explanation: because 和 so 不能同时使用；because 引导原因，so 引导结果。
questions.evidence: Because it was raining, we stayed at home.

options: Although she was tired, she finished her work.
Although she was tired, but she finished her work.
She was tired although she finished her work.
Although she was tired, so she finished her work.
answers: Although she was tired, she finished her work.
questions.explanation: although 表示让步，后面不能再用 but 或 so。
questions.evidence: Although she was tired, she finished her work.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the most uncertainty?
options: I might go to the party.
I can go to the party.
I will go to the party.
I must go to the party.
answers: I might go to the party.
questions.explanation: might 表示可能性较小，语气最不确定。
questions.evidence: I might go to the party.

options: Even if you are late, you can still join us.
Even if you are late, so you can still join us.
Even if you are late, but you can still join us.
Even you are late, if you can still join us.
answers: Even if you are late, you can still join us.
questions.explanation: even if 表示“即使”，后面接主句，不用 so 或 but。
questions.evidence: Even if you are late, you can still join us.

part1: Do you like walking? Why or why not?
Do you prefer exercising alone or with others?
What do you do to stay healthy?
speaking.part2: Describe a club or group you would like to join. You should say: what the club is; why you want to join it; what you need to do to join; and explain how it might help you.
part3: Why do some people prefer indoor exercise?
What are the benefits of joining a club?
Should governments encourage people to exercise more? How?
How might technology change the way people exercise in the future?

transfer.writing: Write an email (about 120 words) to a friend inviting them to join a weekend activity with you. Explain why you think it is good for them, what they need to bring, and when and where you will meet. Use because, so, although, and may/might/can.
